metadata.description: spec.md — an agent-native specification framework for the software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: spec-md
plugins.description: Author and maintain *.spec.md documents: OKF specs that keep intent, behavior, and verification aligned across humans and agents, with an optional executable behavioral model for drift detection and conformance testing. Use /spec-md to author; /spec-md:check, /spec-md:coverage, and /spec-md:model for validation. Single root SKILL.md (no nested skills/spec-md).
